description:
Makelead finds up to 800 prospects a month on LinkedIn and X on the Premium plan. This app brings that account into ChatGPT: your prospects and their status, your campaigns and their pace, and how much of your monthly quota is left.

It also helps you write. Makelead returns the writing context of your account (your voice, your formats, the project brief). You draft the posts in ChatGPT, then save them back to Makelead to schedule them.

A Makelead account is required. Post generation is limited to paid plans.

defaultPrompt: Où en sont mes campagnes de prospection ?
Montre mes prospects LinkedIn qui ont accepté mon invitation.
